name: v0.49.0
body:
## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **GitHub polling needs an allowlist.** New host-only `github.polling_repositories = ["owner/repo", ...]`; empty (the default) ignores every notification, so polling deployments must set it (#4294).
- **Jira `project_keys = []` now disables lookups.** The default is now `["*"]`. If you set `[]` to mean "all projects", change it to `["*"]` or remove it (#4049).
- **`litellm.extra_headers` is host-only.** Repository `.pr_agent.toml` and comment arguments can no longer set it (#4287).
- **Default model is now `gpt-6.1-sol`** with `gpt-6-luna` as fallback (was `gpt-5.6` / `gpt-5.6-terra`). Pin `config.model` to keep the old one (#4088).
- **Langfuse SDK 4.18.0** needs self-hosted Langfuse 3.63.0+; use the `langfuse_otel` callback (#4343).
- **GitHub App token in Actions:** set `github.agent_login` to `<app-slug>[bot]` so PR-Agent recognises its own comments (#4329).

## ✨ Highlights

- `pr-agent doctor` preflights a deployment (#4321).
- `--json-output` for `/describe`, `/improve` and `/review` (#4265, #4227, #4226).
- Jira scoped API tokens (#4250), `/ask` with the CI artifact as context (#4176), globs in `repo_context_files` (#4220), opt-in GitLab subgroup settings inheritance (#4059).
- Security hardening: DNS rebinding block, repo-context path escapes, host-only config output, loguru diagnose off, more credential redaction (#4252, #4279, #4293, #4280, #4328).

## What's Changed
